test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: How many seconds will a boy take to run one complete round around a square field of side 38 metres, if he runs at a speed of 6 km/h?
solution:
**Given:**

A boy runs one complete round around a square field of side 38 metres at a speed of 6 km/h.

**Formula Used:**

Perimeter of the square field, P = 4 × side

Speed, S = 6 km/h = 6000 m/h (since 1 km = 1000 m)

Time, T = Distance / Speed

**Calculation:**

Perimeter of the square field, P = 4 × 38

⇒ P = 152 

Speed, S = 6000 m/h

Convert speed to m/s: (6000)/(3600) 

⇒ S = 1.6667 

Time, T = Distance / Speed

⇒ T = (152)/(1.6667) 

⇒ T = 91.2 

**∴ The correct answer is 91.2 (2).**
